weby.lead: We build websites that deliver results. Design, performance and strategy in one.

includes.title: Designed for you

faq.q: How long does a new website take?
faq.a: Typically 4–8 weeks depending on scope. You'll get an exact date after the first consultation.

faq.q: Can I manage the site myself?
faq.a: Yes. We connect the site to a CMS and hand over a short training plus documentation.

faq.q: What do you need from me?
faq.a: A basic idea of the goal, company materials and photos. We'll figure out the rest together.

headline: SEO that brings
results
seo.lead: We improve your visibility in search and bring in relevant visitors.

includes.title: Analysis and audit
includes.text: We find what holds the site back — technically, in content and against competitors.

includes.title: Keywords
includes.text: We find queries that actually lead to enquiries, not just visits.

includes.title: Technical optimisation
includes.text: Speed, indexing, structured data, internal linking.

includes.title: Content
includes.text: A topic plan and texts that answer real customer questions.

includes.title: Reporting
includes.text: A regular, readable overview of rankings, traffic and conversions.

faq.q: How soon will I see results?
faq.a: First movements usually show within weeks, steady growth is a matter of months. You'll get a concrete estimate after the audit.

faq.q: Do you guarantee first place on Google?
faq.a: No — nobody can seriously guarantee that. We guarantee the process, transparent reporting and work towards measurable goals.

faq.q: Do you do SEO for a site you didn't build?
faq.a: Yes, we start with an audit and propose what's worth fixing first.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This document describes how we handle the data you send us through the form on this site. The text is a template — please have it reviewed and fill in your company details before launch.
privacy.metaDescription: How ELEVATE handles personal data from the enquiry form.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: The controller of personal data is {company}, registered at {city}, {postal}, Czech Republic. Contact email: {email}.

sections.title: 2. What data we process
sections.body: We process the data you fill in yourself in the enquiry form: name, email, optionally phone, the address of your current website and the message text. Plus the technical record of the sender's IP address, used solely to protect the form from abuse.

sections.title: 3. Why we process it
sections.body: We use the data only to reply to your enquiry and prepare a quote. The legal basis is pre-contractual negotiation at your request and our legitimate interest in protecting the form from spam.

sections.title: 4. How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep enquiries for as long as needed to handle them and then for a maximum of 24 months, unless agreed otherwise.

sections.title: 5. Who we share it with
sections.body: Emails are delivered by Resend (Resend, Inc.). The site is hosted on Vercel. If analytics is enabled, we use the cookieless tool Plausible. We never sell data or pass it on for third-party marketing.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.body: By default the site uses no marketing or analytics cookies. If we later enable analytics that requires consent, we will show you a consent bar before anything is stored.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object. Just write to our contact email. You also have the right to complain to the Czech Data Protection Authority (uoou.gov.cz).
